messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Policy engine crash detected for smart-routing policy (service=policy-eval, env=prod). Error spike -> 5xxs on routed requests. Auto-fallback attempted but some requests are looping. Initial detection at 2025-11-02T14:10:56Z. thread_ts=1765423456

incident-bot: Alert details: error_rate=12.3% (5m), impacted_customers=[AcmeCorp, BrightRetail], affected_regions=[us-west2], recent log snippet: ```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 4521 [running]:
github.com/redwood/policy/eval.(*Engine).Eval(0xc0002d0000, 0xc0003b4000, 0x0)
	/monorepo/policy/engine.go:213 +0x21f
```

sara: acked. I'm on pager. starting quick triage. :eyes:

sara: checking policy eval logs now. pulling the last 100 lines from policy-eval in us-west2.

miguel: on call support here. i saw similar NPE in staging last month after a bad rule push. could be malformed expression in rollout rules. any recent policy updates?

ops-bot: Recent config change: `policy smart-routing` updated by `deploy-bot` at 2025-11-02T13:58:21Z (commit: 9f3c2a7). Diff: +rule #42: `region == "us-west" && weight > nil` (added).

priya: if that's true the `weight > nil` would evaluate to an invalid expression. suggest disabling the policy to stop evals and fallback loops.

miguel: agree. plan: 1) disable smart-routing policy 2) force traffic to default model variant in us-west2 3) collect full stack traces and policy payloads 4) roll back offending rule.

sara: executing disable now: `redwoodctl policy disable --name smart-routing --env=prod`

ops-bot: Command received: `redwoodctl policy disable --name smart-routing --env=prod` by sara. Policy disable initiated.

incident-bot: Policy disable acknowledged by control plane. New evals should be skipped; system will route to default routing policy. Observability: watch for error_rate drop.

sara: error rate dropping from 12.3% -> 2.1% over 90s. some users still report 500s, likely cached faulty KV for routing.

dave: could be fallback loop: policy disabled but routing table still has entries forcing a variant that triggers the eval path on proxy. propose forcing route override: `redwoodctl route override --region=us-west2 --model=redwood-llama-13b-v1 --ttl=15m`

priya: applying route override now. `redwoodctl route override --region=us-west2 --model=redwood-llama-13b-v1 --ttl=15m` -> applied.

ops-bot: Route override applied. Cache invalidation kicked for region us-west2.

customer-success: FYI, reached out to AcmeCorp and BrightRetail. They saw degraded responses between 14:08-14:16 UTC. We're offering status updates and will follow-up with postmortem.

miguel: logs show the exact panic: ```
2025-11-02T14:09:03Z policy-eval[4521]: panic: invalid expression: unexpected token "nil" at ruleset smart-routing:rule#42
2025-11-02T14:09:03Z policy-eval[4521]: stack trace...
```

miguel: found offending rule text in commit 9f3c2a7. creating rollback: `git revert 9f3c2a7 --no-edit` and will push through policy CI.

sara: rolling handoff: i'm good to monitor for next 30m then handing to miguel for deeper postmortem and patch rollout. miguel, you taking?

miguel: i’ll take the incident. diving into CI/system tests to catch expression parser gaps. we'll patch the parser to return a validate error instead of panic.

priya: opening temporary mitigation ticket and tagging eng-runtime + eng-platform. ticket: "INC-2025-1102-01 - policy-eval panic on invalid expressions". Priority P1 for follow-up.

customer-success: customers notified. CS will send a follow-up email once postmortem is available.

miguel: preliminary root cause: naive parser allowed `nil` literal in binary comparisons, leading to an unhandled code path. fix plan: 1) add validation in policy upload (reject rules with `nil` comparisons), 2) make evaluation resilient (guard against nil), 3) add unit & fuzz tests.

dave: also add a safe-fallback route config: if policy eval errors, route to default variant w/o re-invoking eval. prevents loops.

ops-bot: Scheduled rollback: `git revert 9f3c2a7` queued to policy-ci; will auto-deploy to canary in 5m, full rollout after validation.

miguel: deploying hotfix branch for parser validation, will coordinate with QA for canary. ETA 45m.

sara: handing active pager to miguel. i'm stepping off but will watch #incidents for updates. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (policy disabled + route override). Customer impact: partial (some requests 500s between 14:08-14:16 UTC). Next steps: follow-up postmortem, CI validation bump, and changelog update.

priya: created postmortem draft: `docs/incidents/INC-2025-1102-01-draft.md` and assigned to miguel.

miguel: noted. will produce final postmortem and link to the rollback PR and tests. assigning owners: eng-runtime for parser fix, eng-platform for safe-fallback behavior.

customer-success: thanks team. we'll keep customers updated.

sara: closing my active oncall. miguel has the wheel.

miguel: closing thread for now, will reopen if rollback fails or errors reappear. follow-up items: root cause analysis, release note, add policy upload validation, add e2e test for fallback loop. :white_check_mark:
